Sources & credits

Team concept and supplied GameMaker v11 project. Web v13 migration, code, narrative adaptation and procedural chiptune developed with AI assistance. Included images originate in the supplied project and are labelled AI-assisted. The custom bitmap font originates in the preceding web implementation.

The team retains responsibility for permission to distribute supplied assets. No new third-party game sprites or music were imported. Aurelia is fictional; NASA, ESA and Nobel institutions do not endorse this game.

NASA Mars Fact Sheet

Verified context; simplified in game

Mars/Earth solar irradiance ratio is 0.431. The game uses an explicitly simplified 0.85 cruise generation factor for balance. This is not an orbital or surface power model.

NASA Ames Trajectory Browser

Team-transcribed scenarios

The v11 file attributes 272/288/352-day routes and delta-v to this browser. Exact query/export was not supplied: these scenario values remain unverified, not certified trajectories.

NASA · travel time to Mars

Scientific context

Typical travel takes roughly 7–10 months. The Venus scenario is an explicitly longer extension.

ESA Mars Express · signal delay

Scientific context

About 4–24 minutes one way. The displayed linear interpolation is illustrative. Timed decisions represent onboard autonomy, not instant commands from Earth.

Bogo et al. (2017) · diapause and colony initiation

Terrestrial study

Mating status and pre-diapause weight affected outcomes in terrestrial rearing. Corrects the v11 misattribution of DOI 10.1007/s13592-017-0529-z to Alford (1969). Does not validate space transport.

Smithsonian · STS-41-C bee enclosure

Historical context

Honeybees were studied in orbit; this is not evidence for dormant bumblebee queens on a Mars voyage.

JPL · Concept Maturity Levels

Design inspiration

Design reviews are inspired by maturity levels. Grants and approval criteria are fictional.

Model assumptions

Credit prices, launcher/cruise-bus profiles, linear delta-v penalty, risk, events, temperature/humidity targets and greenhouse outcomes are educational assumptions. The fictional human journey is not included in the cargo mass model. The epilogue imagines an award after further research; it is not a prediction.

Privacy

The game uses browser local storage for one save and audio preferences. No gameplay analytics or account system is included in the game code. Exported mission files contain choices and simulated results.
